scope.dataset_note: Parent host remotely rehashed the original library and froze the 20k prefix on 2026-10-13. This local evaluator rehashes its manifest binding, not the large remote subset; native execution must independently bind selection provenance. Historical results are not retroactively assigned to the subset.

target.name: EGFR
target.construct: Deposited 1M17 EGFR kinase construct; five cloning artifacts; no disease mutation claim
target.coordinate_acceptance: Explicitly observed-and-modeled protein with full atom provenance. All 11 independent v2.1 checks must pass; modeled occupancy0 does not represent experimental occupancy. A failed proposal blocks execution.

acceptance.minimum_accepted_candidates_rationale: Operational minimum for a nonempty shortlist, not an estimate of potency or binding probability. Applies prospectively; historical output never inherits this objective.
acceptance.engine_scores: Finite scores with exact per-candidate identity are required; no score value is treated as measured affinity.
acceptance.failure_policy: Missing or unsupported evidence is unknown; a fully checked round with zero passing candidates is a valid stop, not objective success.
acceptance.retained_stereochemistry: The consumed warhead double bond has no retained E/Z requirement. All other specified parent stereochemistry must match pose coordinates; new adduct stereochemistry is unassigned.

provenance.use: Deposited human EGFR kinase construct identity and no annotated mutations; exact local bytes independently pinned.
DBREF and SEQADV interpretation; local records bind author773 to UniProt797.
Published default heavy-atom distance/plane tolerances and protein vdW ratio. Numerical values copied into this immutable local manifest; remote main is not fetched at evaluation time.
PoseBusters physical plausibility rationale; this custom covalent adaptation is narrower and not validated by that noncovalent benchmark.
Bounds matrix lower/upper triangle semantics and frozen API options.

adaptations: CarsiDock product identity must invert a unique terminal-sulfur Michael adduct to the exact full parent graph. Unsupported products are unknown.
The sulfur placeholder must coincide with PDB SG within 0.001 angstrom per-axis serialization tolerance; this is an identity check, not a physical bond cutoff.
The actual receptor CB/CA fragment is joined to the placeholder sulfur for local covalent bond/angle/internal bounds checks. Protein clash checks exclude only declared covalent 1-2/1-3 pairs.
Use fixed heavy-atom protein ATOM coordinates; receptor waters and co-crystallized reference ligand are not competitors in this shortlist check.
No ligand-specific parent RMSD, strain or interaction threshold is transferred from the Ligand-first route.
limitations: This is a versioned local geometric shortlist policy, not full PoseBusters and not experimental activity, selectivity, kinetics, toxicity, synthesis or drug efficacy validation.

No redocking/native-pose RMSD, energy minimization, conformer energy ratio, full clash-volume, amide/double-bond planarity, molecular dynamics, or exhaustive stereoisomer/protonation ensemble is evaluated.
No universal covalent docking validation is claimed for the custom Michael-adduct boundary treatment.
The deposited receptor has 2.60 angstrom experimental resolution and is treated as rigid; biological flexibility and structure uncertainty remain.
Passing candidates require subsequent orthogonal/experimental validation. Historical local evaluation is retrospective and is not a prospective pilot.
This evaluator alone does not authenticate native delivery, release/contract/selection provenance, consumed budget, or a frozen library subset; the host must bind these separately.
Full deposited loop, cloning segment, termini and unsupported sidechains were modeled; current prepared proposal FAILED its independent audit and is not pilot-ready.
A geometric pass would still not establish modeled-loop accuracy, protonation populations, experimental occupancy or biological efficacy.

prepared_receptor_semantics.failure_policy: Any required receptor check fails or is absent: withhold candidate geometric conclusion and reject native pilot admission. Do not modify thresholds or overwrite failed evidence.
